task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text: I've hardened the importer: one bad row no longer stops the import, and names with commas now come through intact. The 4 existing tests (3 of which failed before) and 17 new ones all pass under `dotnet run --project tests`. There's no new dependency; the parsing is still in-house
digest: Read 2 files (2 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 2 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
